description: The number 2260 does not appear as a symbolically significant number in the Bible or in known Jewish numerological traditions (gematria). It cannot be confirmed that the number occurs as an explicit numerical value in any biblical verse. It is not among the numbers traditionally emphasized in biblical numerology, such as 7, 12, 40, or 613, and it is not assigned a specific symbolic value in any known rabbinic or Kabbalistic source.

In the Jewish calendar, the year 2260 from creation (approximately 1500 BC) can be linked to the period around Moses and the Exodus from Egypt, but the number itself is not assigned a specific symbolic value. It is not among the numbers traditionally emphasized in biblical numerology, such as 7, 12, 40, or 613.
versions.reason: [major] The description states that the year 2260 from creation corresponds to 'approximately 1500 BC' and is linked to Moses and the Exodus from Egypt. The Jewish calendar counts from creation in 3761 BC, so year 2260 would correspond to approximately 1501 BC. This is roughly correct, but the claim that this can be connected to Moses and the Exodus is speculative. The traditional dating of the Exodus varies considerably (from about 1446 BC to 1250 BC). This is an interesting observation, but it should be nuanced.; [minor] Numbers 4:40 mentions the number 2630 (two thousand six hundred and thirty), not 2260. The cited verse does not appear to contain the number 2260 directly. It is worth checking whether there are any actual biblical occurrences of this number.; [minor] The information about the Jewish calendar and the possible connection to the Exodus period fits better as a footnote, since it is a speculative observation that interrupts the flow of the description of a number without established symbolic meaning.

footnotes.text: In the Jewish calendar, the year 2260 from creation corresponds to approximately 1501 BC (based on the epoch of 3761 BC). Some have speculatively linked this to the period around the Exodus, but the dating of the Exodus from Egypt is debated among scholars (estimates range from about 1446 to 1250 BC), and the number 2260 itself is not assigned any special significance in this context.
